note: Two 5-column Trimshamsha tables. Surya read them cell by cell in scrambled order and wrapped several degree marks in <math> noise. Read by eye; in each table the five degree spans sum to 30 and the ranges are contiguous.
markdown:
**Odd Sign Lords**

| Lord | Mars | Saturn | Jupiter | Mercury | Venus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Degrees | 5° | 5° | 8° | 7° | 5° |
| Range | 1 to 5 | 6 to 10 | 11 to 18 | 19 to 25 | 26 to 30 |

**Even Sign Lords**

| Lord | Venus | Mercury | Jupiter | Saturn | Mars |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Degrees | 5° | 7° | 8° | 5° | 5° |
| Range | 1 to 5 | 6 to 12 | 13 to 20 | 21 to 25 | 26 to 30 |
